rubric.statement: The program mocks the local launch boundary so `LocalProvider.launch` can run without a real server: it provides an `sglang` import, substitutes `get_free_port`, `wait_for_server`, `subprocess.Popen`, and `threading.Thread`, and launches against an LM-like object with mutable `kwargs`.
Starting from a model string like `openai/huggingface/my-org/my-model`, the program shows that `launch` strips the public prefixes before launch so the effective model path becomes `my-org/my-model`.

The program captures the command passed to `subprocess.Popen` and verifies the exact list-form launcher command: `python`, `-m`, `sglang.launch_server`, `--model-path`, the normalized model, `--port`, the mocked port as a string, `--host`, and `0.0.0.0`.
After launch, the program asserts that DSPy writes `lm.kwargs["api_base"]` as `http://localhost:{port}/v1` and `lm.kwargs["api_key"]` as `local`, using the same port selected for the server.
